office.printAndroid: Opened as PDF - print it from the viewer's menu.

update.fallbackHint: In-app updates are not configured on this build; the download opens in the browser.

welcome.title: Welcome to OmniOffice
welcome.intro: Three things to try first. Everything runs on this device.
welcome.officeBody: Create or open Word, Excel and PowerPoint files (also ODF, CSV and RTF).
welcome.pdfBody: Read, merge, split, compress, sign or OCR a PDF.
welcome.aiBody: Add your own API key or a local Ollama model. It stays off until you set it up.
settings.showWelcome: Show the welcome guide on Home
settings.privacyBody: OmniOffice never uploads your documents. Everything is processed on this machine with bundled open-source engines. No telemetry, no analytics, no cloud. The only exception is the optional AI assistant, which is disabled until you add your own API key (or choose a local Ollama model) and confirm the data notice each time.
settings.aiKeyHint: Stored encrypted (Windows DPAPI / Android Keystore) · never logged
ai.keyKeystore: API key stored with Android Keystore encryption
settings.aiBaseUrlHint: Change only if you use a compatible gateway
settings.aiModelHint: deepseek-flash is the default (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, 1M context); V4 Pro is slower but stronger
settings.aiMaxTokensHint: How long a single answer may be. DeepSeek V4 allows up to 384,000.
settings.aiContextTokensHint: How much document text is sent per request. DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro support 1,000,000 tokens; larger values mean fewer chunked requests (slower, higher cost).
settings.aiThinkingHint: When enabled, the model reasons before answering (better quality, slower, uses more tokens). Turn it off for the fastest answers.
settings.aiThinkingModelWarning: Thinking mode only applies to deepseek-v4-* models; it is ignored for other models.
settings.aiReasoningEffortHint: How much the model may think before answering
settings.aiAutoSave: Save AI results to the library automatically
settings.aiAutoSaveHint: Each finished summary, translation, answer or cleaned text is stored as a Markdown file you can reopen later.
settings.keepOperationLog: Keep an operation log (paths and sizes only)
settings.aiWarning: The AI assistant is the only feature that uses the internet: the extracted text of the document you choose is sent to the provider you select (for example DeepSeek, Anthropic or Google) with your key, or stays on this computer when you use a local Ollama model. Everything else in this application stays offline.

redact.batchNoMatches: No sensitive data was found; the file was left unchanged.

compare.noTextDiffShort: No text differences; only the picture comparison can explain the rest.

inspect.author: Author
inspect.noFonts: No fonts were found in this document.
inspect.noImages: No images were found in this document.
inspect.noFields: This document has no form fields.

jobs.emptyHint: OCR, compression, AI and vault scans appear here.

jobs.interruptedHint: This job was still running when the app closed, so it is not working anymore. Press Retry to start it again.
jobs.retryUnavailable: This job type cannot be retried automatically; please run the operation again from its screen.
sync.title: Cloud Sync
sync.subtitle: Local-first sync for .oswk documents over WebDAV. Off by default; every upload and download is a deliberate action.
sync.offHint: Nothing is uploaded or downloaded until you enable it here.
sync.enableHint: Saving this switch does not transfer anything: uploads and downloads always need an explicit button press.
sync.providerUnavailable: OneDrive and Google Drive require OAuth sign-in, which is not available in this build. WebDAV works now; the other providers are shown for transparency.
sync.oauth.hint: Sign-in opens the provider's own page in your browser; the authorization code comes back to a loopback listener on this machine. Tokens stay in the OS credential vault on desktop.
sync.oauth.clientIdHint: Create an installed/desktop app in the provider's developer console and paste its client ID.
sync.oauth.clientSecretHint: Only needed if the provider requires one for desktop clients (Google does).
sync.oauth.secretStored: A client secret is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
sync.oauth.tenantHint: Microsoft only. 'common' works for personal and work accounts.
sync.oauth.notConnected: Not connected. Save a client ID, then connect.
sync.oauth.storeKeychain: Tokens are stored in the OS credential vault.
sync.oauth.storeFile: No OS vault is available here; tokens use the app's secret store.
sync.allowInsecureHttp: Allow plain HTTP for a local server (loopback only)
sync.allowInsecureHttpHint: Off by default. When enabled, http:// is accepted only for localhost / 127.0.0.1 / ::1; a remote server must always use https://.
sync.passwordHint: Stored with the platform secret store (DPAPI on Windows). Leave empty to keep the saved password; clear the field and save to remove it.
sync.remoteDirHint: Relative to the server URL. Created on the first upload.
sync.testFolderMissing: The remote folder does not exist yet; it will be created on the first upload.
sync.setupFirst: Save the server settings and turn sync on before transferring anything.
sync.filesHint: Local .oswk documents to compare with the cloud. Status is checked only when you ask.
sync.forgetHint: Removes the sync record only; the document and its cloud copy stay untouched.
sync.deleteRemoteHint: Removes the cloud copy of this document. The local file stays untouched.
sync.noFilesHint: Open or create a native document, or add one with the button above.
sync.resolveHint: Nothing is overwritten without your choice.
sync.conflictExplanation: Both the local file and the cloud copy changed since the last sync.
sync.keepLocalHint: Upload this device's version. The write is conditional: if the cloud changed again meanwhile, the upload is refused and you can retry.
sync.keepCloudHint: Replace the local file with the cloud copy. Local changes are lost - keep both if unsure.
sync.keepBothHint: Save the cloud copy as a new “(cloud copy …)” document and leave the local file untouched.
sync.remoteEmpty: No .oswk documents in the remote folder.
sync.downloadHint: The cloud copy is written to a new local file; existing files are never replaced silently.
sync.noBackground: No background sync and no automatic merging in this version: nothing happens while the app is closed.
search.placeholder: Search commands, files and the local index…
search.vaultMissing: The document vault index is empty. Index a folder from the Vault screen to search inside documents.
vault.title: Document Vault
vault.subtitle: Opt-in local indexing and full-text search over your own folders.
vault.privacyBody: Only folders you pick are scanned. The index, extracted text and search results never leave this machine, and no telemetry is sent.
vault.clearHint: Deletes the search index and the extraction cache; the folder selection stays.
vault.clearConfirmBody: The search index and the extracted text cache will be deleted. Folders you added stay configured; the next scan re-indexes their files.
vault.deleteImports: Also delete the imported document copies from app storage
vault.noFoldersHint: Add a folder to enable indexing.
vault.indexMissingHint: Run a scan to build the local index.
vault.savedFoldersHint: Folders saved in a previous session are still indexed; add them again to manage them here.
vault.searchEmptyHint: Type a query above to search inside indexed documents.
vault.previewEmpty: Select a result to preview its text.
vault.androidImportNote: Android apps can only index folders they import documents from. Picked documents are copied into the app's private vault; the originals stay where they are.
compat.title: Compatibility Center
compat.subtitle: What this build can open, edit and save, and what a document loses in each format.
compat.nativeHint: The native .oswk format keeps everything; other formats convert or drop features as listed.
compat.reportHint: The editors call this before saving into a lossy format.
compat.noReport: Open the report from a save dialog to see what a document would lose.
loss.title: Data loss warning
loss.body: {target} cannot store everything in this document. Review what happens to each feature before you save.
loss.summaryClean: Everything in this document is supported by the target format.
loss.summaryTransformed: {transformed} feature(s) are converted rather than kept as-is.
loss.summaryLost: {lost} feature(s) cannot be represented and will be lost.
loss.summaryBoth: {lost} feature(s) will be lost and {transformed} converted.
loss.columnHint: Supported? = the target can represent the feature. Imported? = the feature is listed for this document (the backend report is conservative and also lists a few target limits before the document uses them). Exported? = written as-is. Transformed? = written in a converted form. Lost? = dropped.
loss.nativeNote: The .oswk master format keeps everything, so saving there loses nothing.
conflict.title: File changed outside the app
conflict.body: "{name}" was changed on disk since you opened it. Saving now would overwrite those changes.
conflict.bodyMissing: "{name}" was deleted or moved on disk since you opened it.
conflict.hint: Reload external changes to discard your edits here, or save as a new file to keep both.
writer.suggestingHint: Record edits as revisions instead of applying them
writer.bookmarkHint: Place the caret where the bookmark should point, then add it and insert a reference.
writer.bookmarkExists: A bookmark with that name already exists.
calc.traceEmpty: Select a formula cell to trace its precedents and dependents.
calc.error_ref: A reference points to a cell that does not exist.
calc.error_value: A value has the wrong type for this operation.
calc.error_name: A function or name is not recognised.
calc.error_num: A number is invalid or out of range.
calc.error_spill: The spill range is not empty.
impress.masterHint: Slides inherit theme, background and placeholders from their master and layout.
impress.chartSchematicNote: The preview is schematic; the data lives in the cell ranges.
impress.chartPasteHint: Paste a block of tab-, comma- or newline-separated values; the block lands at the focused cell.
impress.chartDataHint: Values typed here are saved as chart caches and embedded in the exported PPTX, so the chart renders without the original workbook.
impress.chartDataGapNote: Clearing a cell inside a series stores 0; clearing the last cell shortens the series.
impress.chartRangeOnlyHint: This chart only carries cell ranges. Type or paste the values here so exports render everywhere.
impress.animationMissingObject: Choose an object for this animation.
impress.footerHint: Applies to every slide in the presentation.
vault.localNote: Everything stays on this computer; nothing is uploaded.
studio.title: PDF Studio
studio.revocationOffline: The online revocation check could not run; showing the offline result.
settings.onlineRevocation: Check certificate revocation online when verifying signatures
settings.onlineRevocationHint: Contacts the certificate authority's OCSP and CRL servers named in the signer's certificate (they see its serial number, not your document). Off by default.
studio.subtitle: Sanitize, flatten and validate PDFs against PDF/A - every result is a real check.
studio.sanitizeHint: Removes JavaScript, embedded files, launch actions, unsafe annotations and metadata, then reports what was removed.
studio.sanitizeVerify: Run Inspect on the result to confirm the risky content is gone.
studio.repairHint: Rebuilds a damaged PDF, recovering files the reader cannot open. qpdf is used when it is installed; otherwise the built-in engine does the work. The result is written next to the original; the original is left untouched.
studio.repairMethodBuiltin: Repaired with the built-in engine (qpdf is not needed).
studio.flattenHint: Burns annotation and form appearances into the page content and removes the interactive objects.
studio.pdfaHint: Structural validation against PDF/A-1b, -2b and -3b. Conversion applies the fixes that are achievable and re-validates; it never claims compliance without it.
studio.pdfaStillFailing: Conversion applied; the document is still not compliant (see the failing checks).
studio.signaturesHint: Real CMS/PKCS#7 detached signatures (SHA-256). Verification runs locally against the embedded certificate; trust is reported as unknown because this build has no system trust store. Revocation is only checked online if you turn that on in Settings.
studio.noSignatures: No digital signatures found in this document.
studio.superseded: Updated after this signature (still valid for its own revision)
studio.ltvHint: Writes the certificate chains the signatures need into the document itself (DSS), as an update that leaves every signature exactly as it was. Nothing is downloaded.
studio.noStoreCertificates: No personal certificates found. Use a PFX/P12 file instead.
studio.storeSigningNote: Signing with a store certificate requires an exportable private key. If Windows blocks the export the app says so and asks for a PFX file - nothing is faked.
studio.pfxHint: The password is used in memory only and is never stored or logged.
studio.androidPfxNote: On Android, choose a .p12/.pfx file; the Windows certificate store is not available.
studio.tsaUrlHint: The signature value is timestamped by the TSA over HTTPS and the token is embedded; a TSA failure fails the signing instead of silently skipping the timestamp.
studio.timestampNone: No RFC 3161 timestamp on this signature.
studio.objectsHint: Real AcroForm fields and page objects. Fill writes /V and rebuilds widget appearances; object edits rewrite the annotation rectangle or the image placement matrix. Text and vector graphics inside content streams cannot be located safely and are not listed.
studio.noFields: No form fields found in this document.
studio.textRunsHint: Edit the text of existing runs in place: the font and position stay the same and the result is saved as a new revision, so signatures over the original stay valid. Positions are approximate.
studio.noTextRuns: No text runs on this page. Scanned pages have no text layer - run OCR first.
studio.textReplaceHint: Only text the run's font can represent is accepted; a run whose font cannot encode the text is refused, never garbled.
studio.textKeepPosition: Font, position and every other run stay unchanged.
studio.noObjects: No annotations or images on this page.
studio.noIssues: No provable issues found in the current values.
studio.unsupportedField: This field type cannot be filled from here.
studio.selectObjectHint: Tap an object to select it, drag to move, use the handles to resize.
studio.issue.optionNotInList: Value is not in the option list
studio.issue.invalidDate: Value does not look like a date
studio.issue.invalidNumber: Value does not look like a number
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Sandboxed extensions: each plugin runs in a worker with only the permissions its manifest declares.
plugins.sandboxNote: Plugin code runs in a Web Worker without DOM or system access. Every capability goes through the app host and is checked against the manifest permissions; documents and files stay under the app's control.
plugins.emptyHint: Install a folder that contains manifest.json and main.js, or reload the bundled sample plugin.

presend.failed: This file could not be checked (it may be encrypted or damaged). You can still send it.
presend.allClear: Nothing that should not leave was found: no personal data, notes, attachments or scripts.

deadline.subtitle: The last day of a court period from an e-notice: 7/a service, holidays, weekends and the judicial recess.
deadline.readPdf: Read the dates from an e-notice PDF
deadline.readPdfHint: The text of the first pages is searched; you confirm the date.
deadline.noDates: No date was found in the PDF's text. Type the date below.
deadline.preset.sevenDays: 7 days (İİK objection to a payment order)
deadline.electronic: Electronic notification (Tebligat Kanunu 7/a): served at the end of the fifth day after it arrives
deadline.recess: Judicial recess (HMK 104): a period ending 20 July – 31 August ends on 7 September
deadline.step.recess: That falls in the judicial recess, so it moves to {date}.
deadline.step.nonWorking: {skipped} is not a working day, so the last day is {date}.
deadline.halfDay: The last day is a half-day eve: courts close at 12:30–13:00. File in the morning.
deadline.outsideTable: The holiday table covers 2020–2029; religious holidays outside it are not counted. Check the last day.
deadline.invalid: Enter a valid date and a period of at least one day.
deadline.disclaimer: An aid for checking periods, not legal advice. Special rules (CMK, urgent matters, a judge's order) are not modelled; confirm the last day yourself.
